options.name: extaddr
options.description: External FQDN address name.

options.name: extintf
options.description: Interface connected to the source network that receives the packets that will be forwarded to the destination network.

options.name: extip
options.description: IP address or address range on the external interface that you want to map to an address or address range on t he destination network.

options.name: extport
options.description: Incoming port number range that you want to map to a port number range on the destination network.

options.name: gratuitous_arp_interval
options.description: Enable to have the VIP send gratuitous ARPs. 0=disabled. Set from 5 up to 8640000 seconds to enable.

options.name: http_cookie_age
options.description: Time in minutes that client web browsers should keep a cookie. Default is 60 seconds. 0 = no time limit.

options.name: http_cookie_domain
options.description: Domain that HTTP cookie persistence should apply to.

options.name: http_cookie_domain_from_host
options.description: Enable/disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP. choice | disable | Disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP (use http-cooke-domain setting). choice | enable | Enable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.

options.name: http_cookie_generation
options.description: Generation of HTTP cookie to be accepted. Changing invalidates all existing cookies.

options.name: http_cookie_path
options.description: Limit HTTP cookie persistence to the specified path.

options.name: http_cookie_share
options.description: Control sharing of cookies across virtual servers. same-ip means a cookie from one virtual server can be used by another. Disable stops cookie sharing. choice | disable | Only allow HTTP cookie to match this virtual server. choice | same-ip | Allow HTTP cookie to match any virtual server with same IP.

options.name: http_ip_header
options.description: For HTTP multiplexing, enable to add the original client IP address in the XForwarded-For HTTP header. choice | disable | Disable adding HTTP header. choice | enable | Enable adding HTTP header.

options.name: http_ip_header_name
options.description: For HTTP multiplexing, enter a custom HTTPS header name. The orig client IP address is added to this header. If empty, X-Forwarded-For is used.

options.name: http_multiplex
options.description: Enable/disable HTTP multiplexing. choice | disable | Disable HTTP session multiplexing. choice | enable | Enable HTTP session multiplexing.

options.name: https_cookie_secure
options.description: Enable/disable verification that inserted HTTPS cookies are secure. choice | disable | Do not mark cookie as secure, allow sharing between an HTTP and HTTPS connection. choice | enable | Mark inserted cookie as secure, cookie can only be used for HTTPS a connection.

options.name: ldb_method
options.description: Method used to distribute sessions to real servers. choice | static | Distribute to server based on source IP. choice | round-robin | Distribute to server based round robin order. choice | weighted | Distribute to server based on weight. choice | least-session | Distribute to server with lowest session count. choice | least-rtt | Distribute to server with lowest Round-Trip-Time. choice | first-alive | Distribute to the first server that is alive. choice | http-host | Distribute to server based o

options.name: mapped_addr
options.description: Mapped FQDN address name.

options.name: mappedip
options.description: IP address or address range on the destination network to which the external IP address is mapped.

options.name: mappedport
options.description: Port number range on the destination network to which the external port number range is mapped.

options.name: max_embryonic_connections
options.description: Maximum number of incomplete connections.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values

options.name: monitor
options.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

options.name: name
options.description: Virtual IP name.

options.name: nat_source_vip
options.description: Enable to prevent unintended servers from using a virtual IP. Disable to use the actual IP address of the server as the source address. choice | disable | Do not force to NAT as VIP. choice | enable | Force to NAT as VIP.

options.name: outlook_web_access
options.description: Enable to add the Front-End-Https header for Microsoft Outlook Web Access. choice | disable | Disable Outlook Web Access support. choice | enable | Enable Outlook Web Access support.

options.name: persistence
options.description: Configure how to make sure that clients connect to the same server every time they make a request that is part of the same session. choice | none | None. choice | http-cookie | HTTP cookie. choice | ssl-session-id | SSL session ID.

options.name: portforward
options.description: Enable/disable port forwarding. choice | disable | Disable port forward. choice | enable | Enable port forward.

options.name: portmapping_type
options.description: Port mapping type. choice | 1-to-1 | One to one. choice | m-to-n | Many to many.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol to use when forwarding packets. choice | tcp | TCP. choice | udp | UDP. choice | sctp | SCTP. choice | icmp | ICMP.

options.name: realservers
options.description: EXPERTS ONLY! KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API IS REQUIRED! List of multiple child objects to be added. Expects a list of dictionaries. Dictionaries must use FortiManager API parameters, not the ansible ones listed below. If submitted, all other prefixed sub-parameters ARE IGNORED. This object is MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with its options. We expect that you know what you are doing with these list parameters, and are leveraging the JSON API Guide. WHEN IN DOUBT, USE THE SUB OPTIONS BELOW INSTEAD TO CREATE OB

options.name: realservers_client_ip
options.description: Only clients in this IP range can connect to this real server.

options.name: realservers_healthcheck
options.description: Enable to check the responsiveness of the real server before forwarding traffic. choice | disable | Disable per server health check. choice | enable | Enable per server health check. choice | vip | Use health check defined in VIP.

options.name: realservers_holddown_interval
options.description: Time in seconds that the health check monitor monitors an unresponsive server that should be active.

options.name: realservers_http_host
options.description: HTTP server domain name in HTTP header.

options.name: realservers_ip
options.description: IP address of the real server.

options.name: realservers_max_connections
options.description: Max number of active connections that can be directed to the real server. When reached, sessions are sent to their real servers.

options.name: realservers_monitor
options.description: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

options.name: realservers_port
options.description: Port for communicating with the real server. Required if port forwarding is enabled.

options.name: realservers_seq
options.description: Real Server Sequence Number

options.name: realservers_status
options.description: Set the status of the real server to active so that it can accept traffic. Or on standby or disabled so no traffic is sent. choice | active | Server status active. choice | standby | Server status standby. choice | disable | Server status disable.

options.name: realservers_weight
options.description: Weight of the real server. If weighted load balancing is enabled, the server with the highest weight gets more connections.

options.name: server_type
options.description: Protocol to be load balanced by the virtual server (also called the server load balance virtual IP). choice | http | HTTP choice | https | HTTPS choice | ssl | SSL choice | tcp | TCP choice | udp | UDP choice | ip | IP choice | imaps | IMAPS choice | pop3s | POP3S choice | smtps | SMTPS

options.name: service
options.description: Service name.

options.name: src_filter
options.description: Source address filter. Each address must be either an IP/subnet (x.x.x.x/n) or a range (x.x.x.x-y.y.y.y). Separate addresses with spaces.

options.name: srcintf_filter
options.description: Interfaces to which the VIP applies. Separate the names with spaces.

options.name: ssl_algorithm
options.description: Permitted encryption algorithms for SSL sessions according to encryption strength. choice | high | High encryption. Allow only AES and ChaCha. choice | medium | Medium encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, and RC4. choice | low | Low encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, RC4, and DES. choice | custom | Custom encryption. Use config ssl-cipher-suites to select the cipher suites that are allowed.

options.name: ssl_certificate
options.description: The name of the SSL certificate to use for SSL acceleration.

options.name: ssl_cipher_suites
options.description: EXPERTS ONLY! KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API IS REQUIRED! List of multiple child objects to be added. Expects a list of dictionaries. Dictionaries must use FortiManager API parameters, not the ansible ones listed below. If submitted, all other prefixed sub-parameters ARE IGNORED. This object is MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with its options. We expect that you know what you are doing with these list parameters, and are leveraging the JSON API Guide. WHEN IN DOUBT, USE THE SUB OPTIONS BELOW INSTEAD TO CREATE OB

options.name: ssl_cipher_suites_cipher
options.description: Cipher suite name. choice | TLS-RSA-WITH-RC4-128-MD5 | Cipher suite TLS-RSA-WITH-RC4-128-MD5. choice | TLS-RSA-WITH-RC4-128-SHA | Cipher suite TLS-RSA-WITH-RC4-128-SHA. choice | TLS-RSA-WITH-DES-CBC-SHA | Cipher suite TLS-RSA-WITH-DES-CBC-SHA. choice | TLS-RSA-WITH-3DES-EDE-CBC-SHA | Cipher suite TLS-RSA-WITH-3DES-EDE-CBC-SHA. choice | TLS-RSA-WITH-AES-128-CBC-SHA | Cipher suite TLS-RSA-WITH-AES-128-CBC-SHA. choice | TLS-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA | Cipher suite TLS-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA. choic

options.name: ssl_cipher_suites_versions
options.description: SSL/TLS versions that the cipher suite can be used with. FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | ssl-3.0 | SSL 3.0. flag | tls-1.0 | TLS 1.0. flag | tls-1.1 | TLS 1.1. flag | tls-1.2 | TLS 1.2.

options.name: ssl_client_fallback
options.description: Enable/disable support for preventing Downgrade Attacks on client connections (RFC 7507). choice | disable | Disable. choice | enable | Enable.

options.name: ssl_client_renegotiation
options.description: Allow, deny, or require secure renegotiation of client sessions to comply with RFC 5746. choice | deny | Abort any client initiated SSL re-negotiation attempt. choice | allow | Allow a SSL client to renegotiate. choice | secure | Abort any client initiated SSL re-negotiation attempt that does not use RFC 5746.

options.name: ssl_client_session_state_max
options.description: Maximum number of client to FortiGate SSL session states to keep.

options.name: ssl_client_session_state_timeout
options.description: Number of minutes to keep client to FortiGate SSL session state.

options.name: ssl_client_session_state_type
options.description: How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the client and the FortiGate. choice | disable | Do not keep session states. choice | time | Expire session states after this many minutes. choice | count | Expire session states when this maximum is reached. choice | both | Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

options.name: ssl_dh_bits
options.description: Number of bits to use in the Diffie-Hellman exchange for RSA encryption of SSL sessions. choice | 768 | 768-bit Diffie-Hellman prime. choice | 1024 | 1024-bit Diffie-Hellman prime. choice | 1536 | 1536-bit Diffie-Hellman prime. choice | 2048 | 2048-bit Diffie-Hellman prime. choice | 3072 | 3072-bit Diffie-Hellman prime. choice | 4096 | 4096-bit Diffie-Hellman prime.

options.name: ssl_hpkp
options.description: Enable/disable including HPKP header in response. choice | disable | Do not add a HPKP header to each HTTP response. choice | enable | Add a HPKP header to each a HTTP response. choice | report-only | Add a HPKP Report-Only header to each HTTP response.

options.name: ssl_hpkp_age
options.description: Number of seconds the client should honour the HPKP setting.

options.name: ssl_hpkp_backup
options.description: Certificate to generate backup HPKP pin from.
